summary.text: Sara Feigenholtz is a Democratic member of the Illinois State Senate who has represented District 6 since January 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously served in the Illinois House of Representatives from 1995 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Feigenholtz earned a B.A. in political science and speech and performing arts from Northeastern Illinois University in 1979.
Her professional experience includes working as president of SKF Consulting and as chief of staff to Illinois State Senator John Cullerton.
Feigenholtz represented Illinois House District 12 from 1995 to 2020.
She took office in the State Senate on January 21, 2020, succeeding Cullerton, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
